    // The 2D scalar cross (perp-dot) a.X*b.Y - a.Y*b.X: the signed area of the
    // parallelogram spanned by a and b, positive when b is CCW from a. Equals the
    // z-component of the 3D cross of the lifted vectors.
    Cross(a: Vector2D, b: Vector2D): Number
        => a.X * b.Y - a.Y * b.X;
